{
  "problem_id": "tmm_problem_cf712123ca1f601b",
  "original_request": "Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (constant refractive index 1.52, lossless), with air incidence (index 1.0). Use only lossless constant-index SiO2 (n=1.46) and TiO2 (n=2.40), one layer of each in either order. Each layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm. At normal incidence with s polarization, minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance sampled from 450 to 700 nm at 5 nm spacing. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is the stated target. Use deterministic TMM only, with no RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogate or hardware. Allow at most two executed research rounds with one route and at most 64 solver evaluations per round, seed 17. After observing the actual result, choose a justified adjustment or stop. Do not claim the target was met without the spectrum and independent numeric check.",
  "normalized_request_english": "Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (refractive index 1.52, lossless) with air incidence (index 1.0). The stack must consist of exactly one layer of SiO2 (n=1.46) and one layer of TiO2 (n=2.40) in either order. Layer thicknesses are constrained between 40 nm and 160 nm. The objective is to minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance for s-polarized light at normal incidence over the wavelength range 450 nm to 700 nm (sampled every 5 nm). A mean reflectance below 0.03 is a soft scoring preference. The method must use deterministic Transfer Matrix Method (TMM) without RCWA, FDFD, surrogates, or hardware acceleration. The optimization allows up to two research rounds with one route, maximum 64 solver evaluations per round, using seed 17. Decisions to adjust or stop must be based on observed results and independent numeric checks.",
  "primary_intent": "design",
  "secondary_intents": [
    "optimize"
  ],
  "compatibility": "compatible",
  "compatibility_reason": "The request specifies a planar, laterally uniform, linear, isotropic layered medium under frequency-domain plane-wave illumination, which fits the solver boundary. All materials are lossless and constant-index, and the calculation method (TMM) is supported.",
  "wavelengths_nm": [
    [
      450.0,
      700.0
    ]
  ],
  "angles_deg": [
    0.0
  ],
  "polarizations": [
    "s"
  ],
  "target_observables": [
    "reflectance"
  ],
  "preferred_behaviors": [
    "minimize arithmetic mean power reflectance from 450 nm to 700 nm",
    "achieve mean reflectance below 0.03 as a soft scoring preference"
  ],
  "suppressed_behaviors": [
    "high reflection in the 450 nm to 700 nm band"
  ],
  "known_stack_materials": [
    "incident medium: air (n=1.0)",
    "layer candidates: SiO2 (n=1.46), TiO2 (n=2.40)",
    "substrate: glass (n=1.52)"
  ],
  "design_variables": [
    "layer order (SiO2/TiO2 or TiO2/SiO2)",
    "thickness of SiO2 layer (40-160 nm)",
    "thickness of TiO2 layer (40-160 nm)"
  ],
  "manufacturing_constraints": [
    "layer thickness must be between 40 nm and 160 nm",
    "exactly one layer of SiO2 and one layer of TiO2"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "materials are non-dispersive within the specified band as implied by constant index values",
    "interfaces are perfectly sharp and planar"
  ],
  "ambiguities": [],
  "method_research_questions": [
    "which layer order and thickness combination yields the global minimum reflectance within the evaluation budget",
    "whether the soft target of 0.03 mean reflectance is achievable given the thickness constraints"
  ],
  "needs_method_research": false
}
